title: I had my coding agent build a game using Godotiq, and here's the result
author: jf_nash
selftext:
I provided my coding agent with free assets and instructions on what I wanted to create: a mini-game similar to [survivor.io](http://survivor.io) or Vampire Survivors, featuring waves, XP for leveling up with corresponding upgrades, bosses, audio, and everything else.

Obviously, it’s just an example,nothing particularly impressive or entertaining,but it was created in less than a few hours of development. There’s plenty of room for improvement, but that depends more on the developer than on the AI or the tool itself.



If you want to try the “game” or start using Godotiq to develop video games with your coding agent, it’s all here:

[www.godotiq.com](http://www.godotiq.com)

To try it:

`pip install godotiq`
